# Girmachew (Gimmy) Samson

> CS student at Georgia Tech and full stack engineer at LegiCycle, an AI platform for legislative research and drafting. Building at the intersection of AI, product, and code.

Girmachew "Gimmy" Samson is a computer science student at the Georgia Institute of Technology, a LinkedIn Future Possibilities in Tech Scholar, and a Teamsters Scholarship Fund recipient. He is a full stack engineer at LegiCycle, where he works on the AI platform legislators use to research, draft, and stress-test bills, and has shipped several AI and web products as a solo developer.

## Experience

- Full Stack Engineer, LegiCycle (Aug 2026 – Present) — building on the AI platform legislators use to research, draft, and stress-test bills; audits a live AWS deployment against NIST 800-53 and OWASP (30+ high-severity vulnerabilities closed, secrets migrated to Doppler across Dockerized services) and expanded its PostgreSQL/Redis-backed RAG research assistant from Georgia-only to Georgia, Delaware, and federal law.
- Member, ColorStack (Aug 2026 – Present) — member of the non-profit connecting Black and Latinx students to opportunities in computer science.
- AI Trainer & Evaluator, Handshake (June 2026 – July 2026) — evaluated and refined AI-generated code across Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Java; designed prompts for multimodal macOS AI agents; contributed to large-scale model training pipelines including OpenAI's Codex.
- Founder & CEO, Bantr (Feb 2026 – Aug 2026) — founded and launched a live debating platform that reached open beta with 250+ users; built the entire product (design, frontend, backend) from scratch with real-time audio/video via WebRTC and live data via Supabase.
- Software Engineer Intern, Sonaara (Aug 2025 – Dec 2025) — shipped React Native features to a production app with 600+ users; built messaging and Persona-based identity verification; helped grow the userbase 73%.
- Freelance Web Developer, Self-Employed (Jan 2023 – Jan 2026) — built 20+ full-stack websites for clients across industries with Next.js, React, and Node.js, averaging a 17% increase in user engagement.

## Projects

- Google Tasks MCP Server (https://github.com/girmmy/google-tasks-mcp-server) — open-source Model Context Protocol server for Google Tasks, published to npm as @girmmy/google-tasks-mcp-server and listed in the MCP registry; 14 tools for full read/write access to task lists and tasks (create, update, complete, delete, move, real due dates) from Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or any MCP client, with a local OAuth flow and no third-party backend. TypeScript, Node.js, Google Tasks API, OAuth.
- Bantr (https://bantr.online) — live debating platform in open beta with 250+ users; real-time audio/video debates, live audience polling, real-time chat, side-voting. Next.js, TypeScript, LiveKit, Supabase, Tailwind.
- Agent Opportunity Tracker (https://gimmy-tracker.vercel.app) — open-source, self-hosted tracker for internships, jobs, and programs that doubles as a Claude/Codex agent skill; agent sweeps the inbox, updates application status, rates fit, and tailors a résumé per listing. Next.js 16, TypeScript, Supabase, Tailwind, Claude Agent.
- Scholarlink (https://thescholarlink.netlify.app) — scholarship discovery platform connecting students with funding opportunities matching their goals. React, JavaScript, Tailwind.
- Transvero (https://transvero.netlify.app) — real-time multilingual transcription app with live audio processing, auth, and PDF export. React, TypeScript, Tailwind, AssemblyAI.
- GimmyAI (https://gimmyai.netlify.app) — full-stack AI-powered assistant serving 130+ active users with real-time NLP and context-aware responses. React, Next.js, TypeScript, Firebase, OpenAI API.
- SymbioAI (https://symbioai.netlify.app) — full-stack AI chatbot with four specialized assistants delivering personalized environmental advice. React, Node.js, OpenAI API.
- ParkviewTSA Website (https://parkviewtsa.org) — responsive frontend for a school TSA chapter; 1k+ clicks and 18k+ total impressions. HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap.
